sloka: तत्कर्म वालिपुत्रस्य सर्वे देवाः सहर्षिभिः ।तुष्टुवुः पूजनार्हस्य तौ चोभौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।। ६.४४.३० ।।।।
transliteration: tatkarma vāliputrasya sarve devāḥ saharṣibhiḥ ।tuṣṭuvuḥ pūjanārhasya tau cobhau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।। 6.44.30 ।।।।

translations.english: As the violent war was going on, the great cheat, Indrajith disappeared from there as Angada had already killed his horses and charioteer.
